gov_railways.ui.operator_hint: The company that runs the railway. Its members (bank access to the company account) open this page in /gov and edit the timetable, without a government role. Only a minister or an admin can change it.
gov_railways.ui.search_operator: Search: state company or private company (name or #id)
gov_railways.ui.routes_hint: Fixed: the stops of every line and the minutes from the first departure (arrival/departure). A timetable rule only picks the line, where the trains start and end, and when they run.
gov_railways.ui.rules_hint: Every rule adds departures: an interval (first to last departure every N minutes) or a single train at a given time. Several rules may cover one line, e.g. every 30 minutes 00:00-05:59, every 15 minutes 06:00-20:59, every 30 minutes from 21:00. Changes reach the trains within a few seconds; trains already running keep their trip.
gov_railways.ui.confirm_delete_rule: Delete this timetable rule? Its trains no longer run (a train already on its way finishes its trip).
gov_railways.ui.departures_hint: The trains of the chosen day as they run, per line (bold = single train; a shorter stretch is shown after the time).
gov_railways.ui.no_trains: No trains run on this day.
gov_railways.ui.tt_offline: The railway timetable (rw_timetable) is not running.
gov_railways.ui.not_loaded: The timetable table could not be read yet: the trains run on the built-in timetable.
gov_railways.err.tt_offline: The railway timetable (rw_timetable) is not running.
gov_railways.err.bad_stretch: The train cannot run between these stations on this line.
gov_railways.err.no_spawn: A train of this line cannot start at this station.
gov_railways.err.bad_last: Invalid last departure (HH:MM, not before the first one).
gov_railways.err.bad_number: Invalid train number (1-99999, single trains only).
gov_railways.err.bad_operator: This cannot run the railway: pick a state company or a private company.
gov_railways.ui.costs_hint: Planned for the next 7 days from this timetable and the running costs of the Public transport page (every stop counted as served).
gov_railways.ui.cost_not_booked: From nobody to nowhere: nothing is booked.
